label: Light rays
desc: Soft shafts of light fan down from a source above the top edge, swaying and breathing; the pointer slides the source sideways.
use: Behind a landing hero, pricing or sign-in section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Light tunnel
desc: A shader tunnel of square light rings with broken segments racing toward a glowing vanishing point that the pointer steers.
use: Behind a launch, event or product hero (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Line waves
desc: A stack of thin horizontal lines rippling like a ridge of waves in a primary-to-signal gradient; the pointer lifts a bump through them.
use: Behind a hero, footer or data section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Liquid chrome
desc: A reflective liquid-metal sheet drawn by a shader: a flowing height field lit as a mirror so dark and light bands slide across it; the pointer dents it.
use: Behind a bold product or brand hero (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Liquid ether
desc: Colour that flows like ink in water from curl-noise currents in the brand colours, swirled by the pointer.
use: Behind a landing hero or AI/product section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Magic rings
desc: Concentric rings of dashed arcs, tick marks and orbiting sparks turning in alternating directions around a glowing core, with a pulse; the pointer shifts the depth.
use: Behind a feature, loading or hero section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Magnet lines
desc: A field of short lines that all rotate to point at the pointer and glow as they near it; a virtual magnet roams when idle or on touch.
use: Behind a hero or call-to-action section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Micro slats
desc: Fine vertical slats that tilt and shade toward a light following the pointer, with a glint on the lit edge; a light sweeps across when idle or on touch.
use: Behind a gallery, hero or footer section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Molten metal
desc: Glowing flowing metal drawn by a shader: a dark cooled crust broken by seams burning primary to signal to white; the pointer heats it.
use: Behind a bold hero or forge-style feature section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Pattern waves
desc: A repeating pattern of dots, diamonds or crosses bent and resized by travelling waves; the pointer sends a ripple through it.
use: Behind a hero, pricing or footer section (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).
